description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the ScreenPermissionService component of the OrangeHRM project. It tests various aspects of retrieving and handling screen permissions, including cases with no permissions, existing permissions, multiple roles, and retrieving screen details. The class sets up mock dependencies and verifies that permissions are correctly assembled based on different input scenarios.

classes.name: ScreenPermissionServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ScreenPermissionService's permission retrieval logic under different scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case by creating an instance of ScreenPermissionService.

methods.name: testGetScreenPermissionsNoneWithNoScreen
methods.description: Tests behavior when no screen is found, expecting default complete permissions.

methods.name: testGetScreenPermissionsNoneWithScreenDefined
methods.description: Tests behavior when a screen is defined but no permissions are set, expecting all permissions to be false.

methods.name: testGetScreenPermissionsOne
methods.description: Tests when one role has specific permissions, verifying correct permission aggregation.

methods.name: testGetScreenPermissionsTwo
methods.description: Tests with multiple roles, verifying permission merging logic.

methods.name: testGetScreenPermissionsMany
methods.description: Tests with multiple roles and permissions, ensuring combined permissions are accurately represented.

methods.name: testGetScreen
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a Screen object based on module and action.

methods.name: verifyPermissions
methods.description: Helper method to assert that the computed ResourcePermission matches expected boolean flags for each permission type.
